description: The argv the claude CLI is launched with (HK-077, HK-080). -p, --verbose, --input-format stream-json, --output-format stream-json and --include-partial-messages always come first, in that order: stream-json output refuses to run without --verbose, and text deltas need --include-partial-messages. --model follows unless the model is empty or "default" (the CLI's own default), --permission-mode whenever the mode is non-empty ("default" is a real mode and is passed), --effort unless it is empty or "default" (no flag means the CLI's default; "max" is accepted, verified live), and --resume with the trimmed id unless it trims to nothing. Values other than the resume id are passed as given.
function: CoreBridge.claudeLaunchArguments(model:permissionMode:effort:resumeSessionID:) ↔ powerup_core::harness::claude::launch::launch_arguments — input {model, permissionMode, effort, resumeSessionID: string|null}; expected: the argument list
verifiedBy: DESIGN.md v1.1 A (verified live against claude CLI v2.1.243); Tests/PowerUpTests/HarnessFixtureTests.swift testClaudeLaunchTable plays it through CoreBridge.claudeLaunchArguments, the argv ClaudeService spawns with since slice 2.3. Rust: rust/powerup-core/tests/harness.rs claude_launch_cases runs launch_arguments.
capturedAgainst: The Swift app (ClaudeService.launchArguments and IOChannel) of PowerUp at ae3de75 (launchArguments extracted unchanged), built with Swift 5.9.2 (Xcode 15.2) and run on macOS 27.2; the flags themselves were verified live against claude CLI v2.1.243 (DESIGN.md v1.1 A)

cases.name: the shipped defaults
cases.reason: A fresh config (model default, permission acceptEdits, effort default) passes only the permission mode (HK-077).

cases.name: an explicit model is passed
cases.reason: A chosen model alias reaches the CLI as --model (HK-077).

cases.name: an empty model is omitted
cases.reason: No model means the CLI's default (HK-077).

cases.name: the default model is omitted
cases.reason: "default" is the adapter's default, not a model name the CLI knows (HK-077).

cases.name: max effort is passed
cases.reason: Ultra is --effort max, which claude -p accepts (verified live; HK-080).

cases.name: a named effort is passed
cases.reason: Effort is a launch flag: there is no live effort switch, so a change restarts the session (HK-077).

cases.name: an empty effort is omitted
cases.reason: An empty effort sends no flag either (HK-077).

cases.name: an empty permission mode is omitted
cases.reason: Without a mode the CLI uses its own (HK-077).

cases.name: the default permission mode is passed
cases.reason: "default" is a real permission mode, unlike the model's "default", so it is passed through (HK-077).

cases.name: a resume id is trimmed
cases.reason: A stored id with stray whitespace still resumes (HK-077).

cases.name: a whitespace resume id is omitted
cases.reason: An id that trims to nothing starts a fresh session (HK-077).

cases.name: an empty resume id is omitted
cases.reason: An empty id starts a fresh session (HK-077).

cases.name: every flag together, in order
cases.reason: The order is model, permission mode, effort, resume (HK-077).

cases.name: values other than the resume id are not trimmed
cases.reason: Only the resume id is trimmed; settings values arrive already clean, and the argv passes them as given (HK-077).
